speaker: will_kemp
text: There. The rope has done what it came to do, which was to be empty. You may look at the end of it. You may not ask me for the animal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking. I did not see the yard. If they laughed, they laughed where I was not.

speaker: will_kemp
text: They laughed. I am telling you because you will invent a worse version if I leave you the silence. The dog is a Christmas story. He does not come on. He is not in this house, and he was not in my hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the rope is the whole of it. I will not put a dog into a memory to keep a laugh warm.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sensible, for you. I have the laugh in my ear, which is where a laugh belongs, and you have the bench. Do not come to the door to study me. I am not a leaf in your book.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: He will not come to the door. He made a rule about it while you were out, and I am already tired of the rule, and I will keep it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it. The rope can lie there. I am not writing it down. A property on a bench is not a scene I was in.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good. Write your own people when you are home, and leave my empty rope out of the moral. I am on again before you have finished being serious.
